The authors note that Fig. 1 appeared incorrectly. The corrected figure and its legend appear below. The online version has been corrected.

caption.p: Broad variation in the findings from 73 teams testing the same hypothesis with the same data. The distribution of estimated AMEs across all converged models (n = 1,253, point estimates shown as hash marks) includes results that are negative (yellow; in the direction predicted by the given hypothesis the teams were testing), not different from zero (gray), or positive (blue) using a 95% CI. AME are xy-standardized. The y axis contains two scaling breaks at ±0.05. Numbers inside circles represent the percentages of the distribution of each outcome inversely weighted by the number of models per team.
